entities.name: Elbrus
entities.description: Legendary rune-etched bone dagger on Innistrad that can trap a demon's essence.

entities.name: Withengar
entities.description: Demon bound in Elbrus, freed by the Skirsdag, who killed Saint Traft.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: Cultists who tricked Saint Traft into releasing Withengar.

entities.name: Saint Traft
entities.description: Monster slayer blinded by the Skirsdag and killed by Withengar.

events.summary: The Skirsdag cultists tricked Saint Traft into releasing Withengar from the blade.
events.quote: the demon Withengar was bound within the blade until the Skirsdag cultists tricked Saint Traft into releasing him

events.summary: The cultists blinded Traft and swapped his sword for Elbrus.
events.quote: They blinded the monster slayer and swapped the sword on his hand for Elbrus.

events.summary: Traft slew the cultists with Elbrus, which freed Withengar.
events.quote: After he slew the cultists with the blade, it freed Withengar in the process.

events.summary: Withengar ended Traft's life while laughing.
events.quote: Withengar ended the life of Traft while laughing

relations.quote: Withengar ended the life of Traft while laughing
They blinded the monster slayer and swapped the sword on his hand for Elbrus.
